categories.main_business_segments: Kaishan Group operates primarily in two segments: compressor manufacturing and geothermal power generation. The compressor segment includes research, development, production, and sales of various compressors such as screw compressors, reciprocating compressors, centrifugal compressors, vacuum pumps, and blowers. The geothermal segment encompasses geothermal resource exploration, drilling engineering, geothermal resource management, geothermal power plant construction (including EPC services and modular geothermal power equipment supply), and power plant operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including proprietary screw compressor rotor profiles, high-pressure reciprocating compressors, centrifugal compressors, magnetic levitation blowers and vacuum pumps, and organic Rankine cycle (ORC) expansion generators for geothermal power. It has developed modular geothermal power station technology that allows staged construction and efficient utilization of geothermal resources. Kaishan also focuses on hydrogen compression technology for the emerging hydrogen economy, including high-pressure oil-free reciprocating hydrogen compressors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kaishan serves a broad range of industries including manufacturing, mining, construction, petrochemical, steel, semiconductor, pharmaceutical, food processing, and renewable energy sectors. Key customers include large industrial enterprises, energy companies, and government utilities. Its geothermal power projects supply electricity under long-term power purchase agreements to national and regional grid operators in countries like Indonesia, Kenya, the USA, Hungary, and Turkey.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with manufacturing bases and sales offices in China, the USA (Alabama), Austria, Turkey, South Korea, Mexico, and Australia. Its geothermal projects and operations span Indonesia, Kenya, the USA, Hungary, Turkey, and other countries. Sales and service networks cover major markets in Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kaishan operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures core compressor components and complete compressor systems, as well as modular geothermal power generation equipment. It also acts as a developer, EPC contractor, and operator in geothermal power projects, integrating upstream resource exploration and drilling with downstream power generation and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-efficiency, energy-saving compressors, hydrogen compression technology, and geothermal power generation equipment. R&D centers in Seattle, Shanghai, Austria, and Alabama focus on axial compressors, expansion machines, high-pressure hydrogen compressors, and dry oil-free screw compressors. Strategic R&D projects include multi-stage ORC expansion machines, heat pump systems, magnetic levitation compressors, and large-scale process gas compressors. The company aims to lead in green energy technologies, including geothermal and hydrogen energy.
categories.revenue_model: Kaishan generates revenue through product sales of compressors and related equipment, EPC contracting and equipment supply for geothermal power projects, and long-term power purchase agreements from geothermal power plant operations. It also earns service fees from operation and maintenance of geothermal assets. The company’s revenue is diversified across domestic and international markets, with a significant portion from overseas operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kaishan is positioned as a leading global compressor manufacturer and a fast-growing independent geothermal developer. It competes with international compressor brands and geothermal equipment suppliers, having broken foreign monopolies in screw compressors in China and expanded globally. Its acquisition of Austrian LMF enhances its presence in high-pressure reciprocating compressors. The company is recognized for energy-efficient compressor technology and innovative geothermal modular power solutions, holding significant market shares in various segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kaishan reported revenues of approximately RMB 4.23 billion, with compressor products accounting for about 68.5% and geothermal power about 18.8%. Overseas revenue accounted for 44.95% of total revenue. The company’s net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 320 million, with a 1.64% revenue growth year-over-year. It has steadily expanded its global manufacturing and sales footprint, with ongoing investments in new plants and geothermal projects. The company aims for overseas geothermal revenue of USD 300 million and compressor revenue of USD 300 million within 3-5 years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kaishan emphasizes its comprehensive compressor product spectrum, advanced energy-saving technologies, and proprietary modular geothermal power station technology that enables flexible, staged development and higher efficiency. Its hydrogen compression solutions cater to the emerging hydrogen economy with superior oil-free designs and high reliability. The company’s global R&D capabilities and integrated geothermal development expertise provide competitive advantages in delivering customized, high-performance equipment and stable, low-carbon energy solutions worldwide.
